brief:
Two Palestinians were hospitalized following a beating by Israeli soldiers during a raid on a refugee camp in Nablus, according to medical sources cited by Middle East Eye. The incident occurred during an Israeli military operation in the occupied West Bank city.

Details of the soldiers' stated purpose for the raid and the extent of the Palestinians' injuries were not immediately available.
dek: Palestinians hospitalised after beating by Israeli soldiers in Nablus Two Palestinians have been hospitalised following a beating by Israeli soldiers during a raid on a refugee camp in Nablus, Al Jazeera reports, citing medical sources.
title: Israeli soldiers beat two Palestinians in Nablus raid
